summary: Northern pike is a large predatory freshwater fish native to northern parts of the Northern Hemisphere. It has been stocked widely for sport fishing. Introduced populations can strongly affect native fish communities.
nativeRange: Northern freshwater regions of Europe, Asia and North America.

features: Light spots on a darker body
Cheeks fully scaled, with scales on the upper half of the gill cover

habitat.description: Often stays near submerged vegetation, fallen trees and other cover.
habitat.diet: Mostly smaller fish, with frogs, crayfish and other small animals taken when available.

eating: Its flesh is eaten, but fish should be thoroughly cooked: the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service notes that pike can carry a tapeworm transmissible through undercooked fish.
